Stillwater Investment Management Llc increased its stake in Apple Inc. (AAPL) by 109.57% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Stillwater Investment Management Llc bought 53,250 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.81% with the market. The institutional investor held 101,851 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $10.68 million, up from 48,601 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Stillwater Investment Management Llc who had been investing in Apple Inc. for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $854.36 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 2.56% or $4.42 during the last trading session, reaching $168.38. About 35.01 million shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49% since April 7, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.94% the S&P500.
